statement: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra Ultrafast inference tier is live on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs, with Vera Rubin GPUs also named, a customer-named design win for NVIDIA's flagship parts.
why: A flagship inference tier from the largest frontier-model buyer running natively on Blackwell and Rubin anchors merchant-GPU demand for the current and next architecture generation.

impact.mechanism: Production deployment of a named commercial inference tier on Blackwell/Rubin locks in merchant-GPU platform demand and the surrounding software stack for serving frontier models.

evidence.source: NVIDIA (official, blogs.nvidia.com, authored by Dion Harris)
evidence.excerpt: is available now in the OpenAI API and to eligible ChatGPT Work and Codex users.

evidence.source: NVIDIA (official, blogs.nvidia.com, authored by Dion Harris)
evidence.excerpt: NVIDIA's deep investment in tooling and documentation has enabled us to make our models exceptionally good at programming Blackwell and Rubin GPUs.

confidence.basis: Primary-tier vendor publication with named on-record quotes from OpenAI's inference lead and CTO of compute confirming the deployment.
